# Solo Travel Security

> Solo Travel Security is a forthcoming independent publication that helps
> solo travellers move through unfamiliar places with confidence, situational
> awareness, and calm. Tactical awareness, not paranoia.

## About this site

- **Status:** Pre-launch — coming soon.
- **Live URL:** https://solotravelsecurity.com
- **Focus:** Awareness, planning, scams, transit, accommodation, and digital
  hygiene for solo travellers.

## Topics covered

- Pre-trip situational intelligence
- On-the-ground awareness and body language
- Money, cards and connectivity hygiene
- Accommodation vetting
- Local scams and how to recognise them
- Transit, taxis and ride-shares
- Emergency protocols and consulate reach-out

## Structure

The site is a single landing page at launch. More pages and a field-tested
playbook will follow once we have verified, on-the-ground contributors in
each region.
